home.badge: Free · No account needed to browse
home.tagline: Your guide to essential services in Atlanta
home.subtagline: Find housing, legal help, healthcare, and more — in your language, near you.
home.languageLine: Free forever · No account required to browse · 7 languages
home.step1Body: Share what you're looking for — in your language.
home.step2Body: Nearby, free, and friendly to newcomers.
home.step3Body: Save resources and follow a clear path.
home.needHelp: What do you need help with?
home.aiTitle: Have a question? Ask our AI assistant.
home.aiBody: Ask in any language — we understand English, Spanish, Amharic, Arabic, and more.
home.emergency: Need immediate help? Call 9-1-1 — free, 24/7, available in your language.

onboarding.whereBody: We'll show resources closest to you.
onboarding.needsTitle: What do you need help with?

onboarding.allSetBody: Fresh Land will guide you to trusted services for housing, legal aid, healthcare, jobs, and more — in your language and near you.

saved.title: Saved Resources
saved.subtitle: Resources you've saved for quick access

settings.changePwBody: We'll email you a link to reset your password.
settings.dangerBody: Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, saved resources, conversations, and posts. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete your profile, saved resources, AI conversations, and community posts. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Please try again or contact support.
settings.resetLinkSent: Reset link sent to your email.
settings.phoneHint: Used only for resource updates you opt into.
settings.householdSizeHint: How many people live with you, including yourself.
settings.countryOfOriginHint: Helps us tailor legal and cultural resources.
settings.languagesSpokenHint: Separate from the app's language — used to match resources.

settings.quietHoursBody: We won't send you notifications during this window.

settings.highContrastBody: Stronger borders and text for easier reading.

settings.downloadDataBody: Export your profile, saved resources, and settings as JSON.
settings.pauseAccountBody: Temporarily hide your profile without deleting it.

pathway.title: My Pathway
pathway.body: Step-by-step guidance for your top needs.
pathway.noneBody: Browse resources to find help for your needs.

welcome.title: Welcome to your pathway
welcome.body: A personal, encouraging guide through the milestones that matter most after arriving in the US. Answer a few questions to get started.

onboarding.title: Let's personalize your pathway
onboarding.q1: How long have you been in the US?
onboarding.q1Sub: We'll show the milestones that matter most for where you are right now.
onboarding.q2: What is your current immigration status?
onboarding.q2Sub: This stays private on your device — it just helps us tailor a few tasks.
onboarding.q3Sub: We'll add school enrollment and family resources if you do.
onboarding.q4: Which one of the following have you got taken care of?
onboarding.q4Sub: Check off anything that's already done — we'll celebrate it and skip the prompt.

header.tagline: Every step you take is one closer to feeling at home.

empty.allDone: All tasks in this phase are complete. 🎉

reminder.title: Set a reminder
reminder.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. We'll still show reminders inside Fresh Land.
reminder.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support notifications. Reminders will appear when Fresh Land is open.
reminder.willAsk: We'll ask permission to send a browser notification at that time.

share.title: Share your win
share.body: You completed "{title}". Sharing your story helps others know it's possible.
share.placeholder: Share what helped, or who supported you. Keep it short — just enough to encourage someone.
share.posted: Your win is live in the Community.

restart.title: Restart your pathway
restart.body: Pick the tasks or categories you want to start over. Everything else stays exactly as it is.

ai.title: Fresh Land Assistant
ai.welcome: Hi! Ask me anything about finding services in Atlanta. I can help in your language, by text or by voice.
ai.trouble: I'm having trouble right now. If you need urgent help, dial 2-1-1.
ai.rateLimited: You've sent a lot of messages — please wait a few minutes and try again.
ai.timeout: The assistant is taking too long. Please try again.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: We hit an unexpected error. You can try again or head home.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you were looking for doesn't exist or may have moved.
errors.resourceLoadFailed: We couldn't load this resource. It may have been removed.
errors.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.

verification.dataFrom: Data sourced from IRS Form 990 filings via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer

disclaimer.legalBody: Information here is general guidance only. For your specific situation, contact a licensed attorney or a free legal aid clinic.
disclaimer.medicalBody: Information here is general guidance only. For health concerns, see a licensed medical professional. If this is a medical emergency, call 9-1-1.
disclaimer.emergencyTitle: If this is a life-threatening emergency
disclaimer.emergencyBody: Call 9-1-1 right away. The resources below are for non-emergency support and follow-up help.
disclaimer.financialBody: Information here is general guidance only. For your specific situation, talk to a licensed financial counselor or tax preparer.
disclaimer.infoCanChange: Info can change — call the provider before visiting.
